assets.title: 自分から続きを求める
assets.scene: An infant about 8 months with short sparse grey-brown hair, round baby proportions, seated securely on a pale cream floor mat on left; mother kneeling on right. Three-quarter side view. The peekaboo game is paused: mother holds her OWN hands together at upper chest below her uncovered face, calmly waiting. Infant actively reaches BOTH arms toward mother's hands, leaning only slightly forward with stable seat, open mouth expressing desire for more. Clear contrast between initiating baby and waiting mother. No toys. Baby light grey romper. Entire pair well inside square, people occupy middle 65%.

assets.title: 道具をやり取りする
assets.scene: Two preschool children, SAME SIZE about 3 years, sitting at a low pale wood tabletop. Left child grey-brown short bob, light grey shirt; right child short grey-brown hair with side fringe, muted mustard shirt. Main focus hands and large pastel wooden blocks in table center. Left child offers one pale blue rectangular block to right child's outstretched hands. A very simple unfinished arch of TWO yellow upright blocks stands on table between them, no lintel yet; one muted coral block rests aside. Heads small relative to table, clearly children not parent. Both children engaged in the block exchange, not building simultaneously. Keep table, heads and hands in frame.

assets.title: 役割を持って参加する
assets.scene: Two preschool children, SAME SIZE about 3 years, sitting at a low pale wood tabletop. Left child grey-brown short bob, light grey shirt; right child short grey-brown hair with side fringe, muted mustard shirt. Main focus hands and large pastel wooden blocks in table center. They cooperate to build ONE tiny bridge: left child uses one hand on each of TWO separate yellow upright blocks to steady them; right child carefully places a pale blue rectangular lintel across both uprights, fingertips on its upper outside edges, keeping hands clear of left child's. One muted coral block rests aside. Heads small relative to table. Clear complementary roles, holding versus placing. No extra towers, no impossible balance. Entire scene inside margins.

assets.title: 相手の作った部分につなげる
assets.scene: Two preschool children, SAME SIZE about 3 years, sitting at a low pale wood tabletop. Left child grey-brown short bob, light grey shirt; right child short grey-brown hair with side fringe, muted mustard shirt. Main focus ONE shared block construction: completed simple bridge of TWO yellow uprights with pale blue rectangular lintel; on right child has built a short flat road of three muted coral rectangular blocks leading to bridge. Left child adds one coral road block at the near end to EXTEND the other child's road toward them. Right child points gently at that open end, both attend to shared construction. Make bridge and connected road dominant, no random scattered block pile, no extra tower, natural hands. Heads small relative to tabletop. Entire scene with margins.
